kernelSource.attribution: sha256 identifies the exact Git module bytes. sourceHashes in the runner identify live harness files, not the selected candidate. No working candidate file or dependency is loaded.

measurement.isolated: One renderer/method active at a time. Other applications may contend; close the visible comparison because pause still renders TAA history.
measurement.gpuSum: Public Three sum from ONE timestamp query resolve per frame. Diagnostic raw timestamps are copied from that same resolved buffer. Pass intervals can overlap, so this sum is not elapsed GPU time.
measurement.gpuSpan: Earliest render-pass begin through latest render-pass end from the same resolved bytes, using the pinned r185 buffer layout without changing library code. Includes gaps within the span, excludes work outside it.
measurement.wall: CPU scene update/render start through queue.onSubmittedWorkDone; includes submission and completed queue work, excludes presentation and timestamp readback.
measurement.scene: Grazing checkerboard, detail1, fixed glide poses t0 and t8. Microbenchmark frame costs, not a whole-game budget or temporal-quality score.
